protocol.ranking: Each arm final confidence, across all eligible classes per video
protocol.cap: At most 2 or 3 detection records per video, not per class; never pad
protocol.selection_ties: Original saved event order; retained events keep original order
protocol.ap_ties: Existing NumPy default argsort, unchanged from baseline
protocol.class_top2: Optional VideoMAE top-3-window mean prior; Normal excluded
protocol.operation_order: Optional class top2 -> final-confidence interval cap -> evaluation
protocol.gt: All GT retained, including classes filtered out and videos with no predictions
protocol.timebase: Saved native source FPS, int-truncated [start,end) frames
protocol.interpretation: Offline sensitivity analysis, not a new inference run
